_comment: Ordered attack replay for attacker.py. gap_s is the pause BEFORE each step, so the narrative has breathing room while the judge reads the OLED.

sequence.say: Attacker sweeps ports. Count-Min Sketch sees distinct-target spread and flags SCAN.
Volumetric flood. Same sketch, different signature -- rate rather than spread.
Payload matches a loaded signature. CAM resolves it in one clock cycle.
One byte flipped in an established session. Poly1305 rejects it.
Structurally invalid encapsulation key -- a coefficient above q. Rejected before any math runs.

The important one. A tampered handshake ciphertext produces NO verdict -- implicit rejection is silent by design. The session establishes normally and the failure only surfaces one packet later, as BAD_TAG. That silence is the Fujisaki-Okamoto property working.
